artworks.title: Louis XIII, King of France
artworks.description: The image shows a man waist up, facing slightly right and looking directly at the viewer. He has long, wavy hair, a mustache, and a small, pointed beard. He wears armor with ornate patterns and a collared garment with lace edges. There are no visible accessories. The background features an oval frame within a rectangular border with decorative elements. Text beneath the portrait describes the individual formally.

artworks.title: Louis XIV, King of France
artworks.description: The image displays a formal portrait of a person from the waist up. The person faces slightly to the left, with long curly hair flowing past their shoulders. The individual wears ornate armor and a sash across their chest. Intricate crests with crowns and designs are in the upper corners. In the background to the left, figures are depicted interacting under archways with celestial elements above. The portrait is enclosed in an oval frame with text identifying the subject.

artworks.title: Jean IV, Duke of Bragance
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper body of a man facing slightly to the right, with his head turned toward the viewer. He has a moustache, a goatee, and medium-length wavy hair falling to his shoulders. The man is wearing a detailed Baroque-style outfit with a high ruffled collar, buttons, and a cross hanging from a cord around his neck. The background shows a public event with people gathered around a stage where a figure is addressing the crowd. The setting has architectural elements like a canopy and a tassel. The scene is enclosed within an oval frame, with text identifying the subject as Jean IV, King of Portugal and the Algarves.

artworks.title: Aluaso Semedo
artworks.description: The image depicts a man seated and facing the viewer. He has a long, pointed beard and wears a tall headpiece. His head is slightly turned to his left. The man has deep-set eyes, a prominent nose, and a calm expression. He is wearing a long robe-like garment and a mantle or wide sash. The portrait is framed within an oval with a decorative border. In the top left corner, there is a crest with a coat of arms containing three symbols. The background features diagonal hatched lines, creating texture. The image appears to be engraved.

artworks.title: Hardouin de Beaumont de Perefixe
artworks.description: The image depicts a man with a long face, a pointed beard, and a moustache. He has shoulder-length wavy hair, wears ecclesiastical clothing, and a large cross around his neck. The background includes an oval frame with detailed line work within a rectangular border. At the top corners, there are heraldic shields with symbols, and text below the portrait identifies the individual as Hardouin de Perefixe de Beaumont.

artworks.title: Gregorius Tarrisse
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of an older man in a hooded garment. The man is facing slightly to his left, with his head turned to the right, allowing a three-quarters view of his face. His facial features are sharp and defined, with prominent cheekbones and a lined forehead, indicating his age. His hair is mostly covered by the hood. He wears a long cloak with a hood over his shoulders, and the fabric appears textured and patterned. There is no visible jewelry, and his hands are not shown. The background is a simple, evenly hatched texture that guides the viewer's focus to the central figure. An oval border frames the portrait, with an inscription below providing identification details about the individual.

artworks.title: Armand de Bourbon
artworks.artist: Balthasar Moncornet after Luggert van Anse
artworks.description: The image is a portrait displaying the upper body of an individual, shown from the chest upwards. The person is facing slightly to the left with their head turned towards the viewer. They have distinct facial features including a pronounced nose, full lips, and clear eyes. The individual's long, curly hair falls past their shoulders. They are wearing a richly decorated garment with a high collar, fastened with a decorative tie at the neck. In the background, there are two heraldic symbols placed in the corners around the oval frame of the portrait. The artwork has a textured, engraved appearance with cross-hatching providing shade and depth. Below the portrait, there is text containing the individual's name and titles, surrounded by an ornate, decorative border.

artworks.title: Thomas Campanella
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a man shown in profile facing left. The man has a prominent nose, deep-set eyes, and a firm chin. He is wearing a hooded garment that covers most of his hair. The man is framed by an ornate oval frame with symbols above it, including a star, a bell, and a pointing hand alongside text. The man wears a hooded garment typical of scholarly or religious figures. The background within the frame is simple, with textual and symbolic elements at the borders.

artworks.title: Jean Pierre Camus
artworks.description: The image displays a man from the waist up, facing slightly to his left but looking directly at the viewer. He has a high forehead, thinning hair, a full beard, and mustache. His expression is solemn and his hair is short and neatly styled. He is wearing a formal robe with a large, dark collar, and a chain with a cross pendant around his neck. The background shows a draped curtain, and through a window, there is a view of trees and a small building, suggesting an outdoor environment. The image is bordered with text identifying him as Messire Jean Pierre Camus.

artworks.title: Victor Bouthillier
artworks.description: This image shows an engraved portrait of a man's upper body, focusing on the chest up. The man is portrayed in a slightly angled position, looking directly at the viewer. His facial features include a broad forehead, pointed nose, mustache, and a goatee. He has medium-length, wavy hair parted in the middle. He is dressed in period-appropriate clothing with an ornate collar and a cross pendant hanging from a ribbon around his neck. The background features an oval frame design with crests in the upper left and right corners.

artworks.title: Jacques-Auguste de Thou
artworks.description: The image is an engraving depicting a bust portrait of a man. The man is positioned facing slightly to his right but gazing towards the viewer. The man has a finely detailed face with a high forehead, sharp facial features, and a neatly trimmed goatee. His hair is short and dark, with tight curls close to his scalp. He is dressed in clothing typical of the late Renaissance period, featuring a detailed, ruffled collar and a dark garment. The background is plain and shaded, focusing attention on the subject, with an oval border framing the portrait. Below the portrait, there is a caption with text in Latin, indicating the subject’s name and titles.

artworks.title: Anne of Austria
artworks.description: The portrait shows the upper half of a woman, focused on her face and attire. She is facing forward with a direct gaze. Her facial features are a rounded face, prominent chin, full lips, and large, dark eyes. Her curly hair is styled under a headcovering, with curls framing her face. She wears an intricate outfit with a lace-trimmed collar and ornate fabric. A wide, decorative collar with lace edges rests on her shoulders. Accessories include earrings and a necklace. The background has fleur-de-lis patterns, a coat of arms on the left, and a chain emblem on the right.

artworks.title: Armand de Bourbon
artworks.artist: Balthasar Moncornet after Luggert van Anse
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait of a person's upper body. The individual is shown in a three-quarter view facing left, with a focus on their face. They have wavy shoulder-length hair, a composed expression, a straight nose, and full lips. The person is dressed in a formal garment with a high collar and buttons, adorned with a detailed brooch or ribbon near the neck. The background features an oval pattern surrounding the subject with textured lines for depth, but no specific setting is visible.

artworks.title: Pierre de Weims
artworks.description: The image is a portrait showing the upper body of a man seated in a traditional pose for a formal portrait. He has a composed expression, with finely detailed facial features including a slight mustache and a small goatee. His hair is shoulder-length, wavy, and dark. He is dressed in formal attire, with a dark, buttoned-up garment and a crisp white collar. There is no visible jewelry, and he is not shown holding any objects. The background is a simple oval frame. Above the portrait, to the left, is a small coat of arms, and to the right, there is a laurel wreath design. The bottom of the image includes text identifying the person as Pierre de Weims, a plenipotentiary for the Maison de Bourgogne, along with a reference to Moncornet as the creator.

artworks.title: A Ceiling Design with Allegorical Figures
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and watercolor on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features swirling lines and curves forming various shapes. The central shape resembles a sculptural torso, with surrounding forms suggesting draped fabric and figures seated or reclining. Soft pastels and muted browns are used, along with decorations resembling garlands and stone carvings.

artworks.title: Christ with Apostles and a Roman Soldier
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a group of figures and angels set against a backdrop of ancient architecture. The scene features a collection of figures in the center with cloth draped around them, set against a background suggesting a historical or mythical narrative. Above the central figures, a group of angels, including cherubic figures, are hovering, surrounded by clouds in the sky. The architecture in the background includes walls or large stone structures, indicating a city or important place. The style is similar to Raphael, with a focus on detailed figures and balanced composition, creating a narrative tableau that is both serene and dynamic.

artworks.title: Portrait of a French General
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a man from the waist up. He is positioned facing slightly to the right, with his body turned away but his head turned towards the viewer. The man has long, wavy hair falling to his shoulders and a mustache with a small goatee. He is wearing a garment resembling a suit of armor with detailed patterns and rivets, and a high-collared shirt underneath. His right hand is holding a slender object, possibly a baton or staff. In the background, there is a draped fabric creating a textured backdrop with an indistinct object in the upper right corner.

artworks.title: Morphine Addicts (Morphinomanes)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of two women depicted from the waist up. The woman on the left appears in a partial profile view, seated and turned slightly towards the right. She features defined facial contours with arched eyebrows, a straight nose, and large eyes, with her dark hair parted in the middle and styled in a classic, smooth fashion framing her face. The woman on the right is shown resting her head on her own hand, with flowing long hair cascading around her face. Her facial features are more obscured and blurred in comparison to the woman on the left. They both wear dark, draped garments. A hand in the foreground holds what appears to be a quill or feather. In the background, there is a large, rounded glass vessel on a table surface. The etching uses intricate line work to create a textured, atmospheric background.

artworks.title: The Silk Gown (La Robe de Soie)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, aquatint, and roulette in brown on Arches laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a woman in a full-length portrait seated in an armchair. She sits in a relaxed pose, leaning slightly to her right with her head resting on her right hand, which is bent at the elbow. She has distinct facial features with dark, wavy hair parted in the middle. She wears a lavish gown with voluminous layers and a light-colored shawl over her shoulders. The background features interior elements like a large piece of furniture, possibly a cabinet or curtain. The portrait is artistically etched, adding texture and depth.

artworks.title: The Lute Player (La joueuse de luth)
artworks.medium: etching in black and brown on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a person holding a lute. The person is seated, facing left, with voluminous curly hair. They wear a loose garment and hold the lute securely. The background has a textured effect resembling aged paper.

artworks.title: The Lute Player (La joueuse de luth)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, and printed tone on Van Gelder laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image features a close-up of a person holding a lute and seated. The person's upper body is visible, with one arm supporting the instrument and the other hand positioned near the strings. The person's face shows defined features with deep-set eyes, a long nose, and slightly parted lips. Wild, voluminous hair adds an expressive element, and they are dressed in textured clothing. The background is a textured, abstract space.

artworks.title: Small Fishing Boats of Berck (Petites Pêcheuses de Berck)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint in brown on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This image features a low-angle view showing figures by the water's edge. In the distance, there are sailing ships with tall masts on the horizon. The ships are depicted with fine lines suggesting movement. The style of the strokes is sketch-like, giving the image an etching appearance. The color palette includes warm brown tones and shades of black against a light sky. The figures closest to us are vague and shadowy, enhancing the focus on the maritime activity.

artworks.title: The Roman Studio (L'Atelier de Rome)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on green laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated at a table or desk, leaning forward with their head resting on their arm. Their facial features are somewhat indistinct, and they are wearing loose-fitting clothing. A small statue of a nude figure is on a pedestal in the foreground. The room has wooden walls or paneling, a large window frame, and another chair to the right of the person.

artworks.title: The Roman Studio (L'Atelier de Rome)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint printed in blue on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a person laying on their side on a surface resembling stairs or blocks. They are reclining with their head resting on one hand. The figure has defined facial features and short dark hair. They appear to be nude. Around them are abstract shapes and patterns, suggesting an indoor setting. A smaller figure is seen in the foreground with one raised arm. The background includes abstract designs, potentially representing furniture or architectural elements. The image is depicted in a blue tone.
